generations.zh: K3 的后训练版本（2026-10-23 发布，2026-11-04 开放权重）：2.8T 总参 MoE、104B 激活、1M token 上下文、原生多模态；官方称在代码、3D 创作、金融研究与长程 Agent 上提升明显，并同步提供 Highspeed 版。
generations.en: Post-trained from K3 (launched 2026-10-23, weights opened 2026-11-04): a 2.8T-parameter MoE with 104B active, 1M-token context and native multimodality; the vendor reports clear gains in coding, 3D creation, financial research and long-horizon agents, with a Highspeed variant.

generations.zh: 当前代（开放日 2026-07-27）。官方 README：2.8T 总参 MoE（Stable LatentMoE，896 专家激活 16），KDA + AttnRes 架构，原生多模态（文本/图像/视频），1M token 上下文；「world's first open 3T-class model」为厂商自评口径。
generations.en: Current generation (open-weights day 2026-07-27). Official README: a 2.8T-parameter MoE (Stable LatentMoE, 16 of 896 experts active), KDA + AttnRes architecture, native multimodality (text/image/video), 1M-token context; "world's first open 3T-class model" is vendor-run wording.

generations.zh: 上一代线：K2 / K2-Instruct / K2-Thinking / K2.5 / K2.6 / K2.7-Code 等在官方 org 在册（2025-07 起）。
generations.en: Previous line: K2 / K2-Instruct / K2-Thinking / K2.5 / K2.6 / K2.7-Code listed in the official org (from July 2025).

generations.zh: 并行支线：视觉语言 Kimi-VL-A3B 与线性注意力 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B（官方 org 在册）。
generations.en: Parallel branches: the vision-language Kimi-VL-A3B line and the linear-attention Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (official org).

sizeTiers.zh: 旗舰 2.8T MoE（K3.1 Pro，104B 激活，1M 上下文）
旗舰 2.8T MoE（K3，激活数官方未逐条公开）
sizeTiers.en: Flagship 2.8T MoE (K3; active count not itemised officially)

licenses.zh: Kimi K3 License（模型卡 license_name: "kimi-k3"，非 OSI 标准许可，下载前读原文）
licenses.en: Kimi K3 License (model-card license_name "kimi-k3"; not an OSI-standard licence — read the text before download)

licenses.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro License（模型卡 license: kimi-k3.1-pro，自定义许可，非 OSI 标准；商用前读原文）
licenses.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro License (model-card license: kimi-k3.1-pro; custom, not OSI-standard — read the text before commercial use)

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：Kimi K3.1 Pro 是「open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model」，2.8T 总参、104B 激活、1,048,576 token 上下文；K3.1 系列首个模型，由 K3 后训练而来。
claims.en: Official model card: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an "open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model" with 2.8T total parameters, 104B active and a 1,048,576-token context; the first K3.1 model, post-trained from K3.

claims.zh: 官方 README：「a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window」「activates 16 out of 896 experts — yielding an approximate 2.5× improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2」（2.5× 为厂商自评口径）。
claims.en: Official README: "a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window"; "activates 16 out of 896 experts — yielding an approximate 2.5× improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2" (the 2.5× figure is vendor-run wording).

positioning.zh: 国产开放权重旗舰：K3.1 Pro 把 K3 的后训练推到新一档，2.8T 总参 / 104B 激活、1M 上下文，权重于 2026-11-04 开放，许可为自定义 Kimi K3.1 Pro License。对话产品「Kimi 智能助手」在网信办首批备案；模型权重与备案是两回事。
positioning.en: The domestic open-weight flagship: K3.1 Pro pushes K3 post-training to a new tier — 2.8T total / 104B active, 1M context — with weights opened on 2026-11-04 under a custom Kimi K3.1 Pro License. The Kimi chat product sits in the CAC first batch; weights and service filing are separate.

onSite.zh: 这里的量化对比目前只覆盖 Kimi K3；K3.1 Pro 权重虽已开放，但尚未进入本站量化系列。
onSite.en: The quantisation comparison here still covers Kimi K3 only; K3.1 Pro weights are open but not yet in this site’s quantisation series.
